A subspace W of a vector space V contains zero and is closed under addition and scalar multiplication. A basis is a linearly independent spanning list.
Every vector has unique coordinates relative to a basis. In a finite-dimensional vector space, every independent list extends to a basis and every spanning list can be reduced to a basis.

A set defined by homogeneous linear equations is a subspace; a nonhomogeneous translate generally is not.
